payload.rationale: The movie 'Why Did I Get Married Again?' was ranked #1 on the US Netflix film chart for the preceding week (September 7-13, 2026). While holding the top spot gives it a strong starting position for the target week (September 14-20), older catalog titles often experience a rapid decay in viewership after their initial surge upon being added to the platform. Furthermore, Netflix typically releases major original films on Fridays (in this case, September 18), which frequently capture the #1 spot for the week. The strongest reason this estimate could be too high is if a highly anticipated new movie was released during the target week, which would almost certainly overtake a catalog title. The strongest reason this estimate could be too low is if the week lacks strong new releases, allowing the film's momentum to carry it through a second week at the top.
limitations: Lack of daily viewership data for the current week.
Unknown slate of competing new releases for the target week.
